title: Battle of South Mountain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of South Mountain", at revision 1377466336, opens: "The Battle of South Mountain, known in several early Southern accounts as the Battle of Boonsboro Gap, was fought on September 14, 1862, as part of the Maryland campaign of the American Civil War. Three pitched battles were fought for possession of three South Mountain passes: Crampton's, Turner's, and Fox's Gaps." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1542829, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1862 battle of the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
